summary: Revision 4 per human-review-2026-07-25-rail-sections: the rail's project name is now a disclosure that expands a lazy folder tree, and the chat header's Files trigger is hidden inside a project (kept for unfiled chats, which have no rail); an Agents section lists the lead agent as a placeholder ahead of per-project agent assignment; DbtlCycle gained an active/done status with a per-cycle complete-reopen control, and the Cycles section auto-minimizes to a count once no cycle is running, with an explicit click overriding the default. Known limitation: the backend file tree is thread-scoped, so the rail lists the active conversation's workspace rather than a project file root. Frontend lint, typecheck, and unit tests pass; routes verified live with a clean dev-server log.
